Website Implementation Notes
Education: use two vertically stacked cards. Give the school, degree and dates the strongest emphasis, followed by the description, with selected modules given the lightest emphasis.
Professional experience: use a timeline or expandable cards. Show the role, organisation, dates and location, a one-sentence overview and key takeaway by default. Reveal 3–4 detail bullets on click.
Music: use a lighter, more cultural visual treatment through photographs, a timeline or a small gallery, distinct from the work-experience cards.
